name: Tran Trung Hau
title: Web Developer
objective: I am a Web Developer with 3.5 years of experience, seeking to become a senior developer with a deep understanding of the full software lifecycle — from frontend and backend development to business analysis and UI/UX design.

Having grown within a diverse team environment, I've developed strong communication and collaboration skills, working closely with AI, Data, BA, and Automation teams. I've also been involved in multiple projects from the ground up, giving me hands-on experience in technology selection, library evaluation, and system architecture design.
In the long term, I aim to grow into a Team Leader and Product Owner role.

experiences.company: VNTT - VIET NAM TECHNOLOGY & TELECOMMUNICATION JOINT STOCK COMPANY

projects.name: Video Analytics System (VMS)
highlights: Developed an API server to manage cameras, users and gateways, and to handle large-scale event data ingestion.

projects.name: Smart City
highlights: Designed the web theme and selected the UI libraries that became the standard for subsequent projects.
Built a multi-app web platform for environment, security and energy operations across buildings, factories, warehouses and industrial parks.

projects.name: Data Lake
